evals.prompt: Give me a browser review of this Markdown blog draft. I want to highlight phrases, leave comments, correct wording, and send my feedback back to you.
evals.expected_output: Running local review URL and persisted session; source remains unchanged. Comments preserve passage anchors and literal edits survive submission.

evals.prompt: Apply my submitted blog-review feedback. The draft has also changed since you opened the review, so keep the new introduction and the MDX components.
evals.expected_output: Read submitted feedback, compare source hash, merge direct edits and interpret comments without overwriting newer work, then write a per-comment applied receipt.

evals.prompt: My review server stopped. Resume the same review so I can finish commenting and submit it.
evals.expected_output: Restart using --resume; recover saved corrections and comments, open the complete access URL, and avoid creating a replacement snapshot.
